details:
This is a request to see if there is interest in bringing back the searchable YouTube walls.  We would possibly also add voting on videos similar to what AltSpace had on theirs.  

If you have a desire for Twitch and Periscope compatibility in VRChat please comment as well on that.
title: Enable videosync to search YouTube from within VR.
